selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a natural resource-gathering-to-construction pipeline. The agent must first mine dark_oak_wood to obtain building materials, then use those materials (along with any other available blocks) to construct an archway gate. Mining wood is a prerequisite for building because the agent needs block resources in inventory before placing them as a structure. This chain is intuitive, doesn't require deep Minecraft expertise, and is visually verifiable — the archway gate is an observable structure. Dark oak wood provides distinctive dark-colored blocks that make the archway visually identifiable.

edges.reason: Building an archway gate requires block materials in inventory; mining dark_oak_wood provides the necessary building blocks for construction

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_wood blocks with the stone_axe drops dark_oak_wood items into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 dark_oak_wood, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block, object=dark_oak_wood) because building an archway gate requires placing blocks in a structure. The player's only building material is mined dark_oak_wood (no planks are given), so checking for dark_oak_wood blocks placed in the cobblestone-marked building area (spawn-relative x=6-14, y=0-5, z=-4 to 4) correctly verifies construction. Requiring min_count=5 ensures a minimal archway shape (e.g., 2 pillars of 2 blocks each + 1 connecting top block). The generous box (±3-5 beyond the cobblestone rectangle at x=8-12, z=-2 to 2) accounts for slight placement variation. This also enforces the dependency: since the player starts with no dark_oak_wood, they must mine it first before placing blocks here.

scene_description: A flat grass clearing (31x31 blocks) with a dark oak tree (3 trunks, 12 dark_oak_wood blocks total) placed 5 blocks ahead of spawn, and a cobblestone rectangle outline (5x5) placed 8-12 blocks to the east marking the archway building area. The player has only a stone_axe — no pre-given building materials. They must mine dark_oak_wood from the tree, then place those blocks in the cobblestone-marked area to build an archway gate.
task_text: Mine dark oak wood from the tree ahead of you, then build an archway gate using those blocks in the cobblestone-outlined area to your right.

Cobblestone rectangle outline (x=8-12, z=-2 to 2) is to the right (+X direction), marking the archway building area. Player receives only a stone_axe — no building materials given, enforcing the mine-first dependency. 12 dark_oak_wood blocks available exceeds the 5 minimum needed for an archway.
